events.title: Freddie Mercury Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, passed away on this day in 1991, having been born in 1946.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost one of the greatest showmen in music. Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury today.

events.title: The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul'.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds incredible, doesn't it?

events.title: John Lennon Death Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon, a founding member of The Beatles, was tragically killed on this day in 1980; he would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, 46 years since his passing. His music and message continue to resonate.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary musician David Bowie was born on this day in 1947.

angles.name: Bowie's 80th
angles.copy: The Starman would have turned 80 today. Celebrating the incomparable artistry and enduring legacy of David Bowie.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, was born on this day in 1935.

angles.name: The King's 92nd
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. His influence on music is simply unmatched.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy Page
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist, Jimmy Page! A true pioneer of rock.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic singer Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod Stewart
angles.copy: Happy 82nd Birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs from Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Suggs
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to Suggs from Madness! Our House in the middle of our street is celebrating.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Paul Young
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to the voice behind some of the 80s' biggest hits, Paul Young!

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Dolly
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon of music and beyond.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Gary Barlow
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! Still going strong.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Billy Ocean
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the legendary Billy Ocean! Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car and celebrate.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony.

angles.name: Rock Hall History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago today, rock history was made with the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who would be in your dream first class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Mark Owen
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to Mark Owen! Another Take That legend celebrating today.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic Rooftop Concert
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Concert Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles took to the roof for their iconic final performance. What a moment in music history!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis frontman and solo artist Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Phil Collins
angles.copy: Happy 76th Birthday to the incredible Phil Collins! A true drumming and vocal legend.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Hugh Grant
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to British acting royalty, Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to drama, he's done it all.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Justin Timberlake
angles.copy: Happy 46th Birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband to global icon.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British actor Sir David Jason celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday David Jason
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to our national treasure, Sir David Jason! Lovely jubbly.

events.title: The Day The Music Died
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, rock and roll pioneers Buddy Holly (born 1936), Ritchie Valens (born 1941), and The Big Bopper (born 1930) tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Remembering The Day The Music Died
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. A tragic day that became 'The Day The Music Died'.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Pop icon Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rick Astley
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to Rick Astley! Never gonna give him up on his special day.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley was born on this day in 1945.

angles.name: Bob Marley's 82nd
angles.copy: The King of Reggae, Bob Marley, would have turned 82 today. His music and message of peace live on.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Acclaimed singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Carole King
angles.copy: Happy 85th Birthday to the phenomenal Carole King! Songwriting royalty and an incredible artist.

events.title: Whitney Houston Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Beloved singer Whitney Houston passed away on this day in 2012; she would have been 64 this year.

angles.name: Remembering Whitney
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost that incredible voice. Remembering Whitney Houston today.

events.title: Take That's original split anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, Take That announced their initial split, breaking millions of hearts.

angles.name: Take That Split Day
angles.copy: Can you believe it's been 31 years since Take That first split up? We're still not over it!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Ali Campbell
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to Ali Campbell, the voice of UB40! Red, Red Wine on us today.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Ed Sheeran
angles.copy: Happy 36th Birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! What's your favourite Ed track?

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The quiet Beatle, George Harrison, was born on this day in 1943.

angles.name: George Harrison's 84th
angles.copy: Remembering George Harrison, who would have turned 84 today. The quiet Beatle, but what a legacy.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The Who frontman Roger Daltrey celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Roger Daltrey
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the legendary Roger Daltrey! The voice of The Who, still going strong.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: 80s pop icon Nik Kershaw celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Nik Kershaw
angles.copy: Happy 69th Birthday to Nik Kershaw! Wouldn't It Be Good to hear your favourite track of his today?

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman Chris Martin celebrates his 50th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chris Martin
angles.copy: Happy 50th Birthday to Coldplay's Chris Martin! Half a century of hits and counting.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Bon Jovi frontman Jon Bon Jovi celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jon Bon Jovi
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to the legendary Jon Bon Jovi! Living on a Prayer for many more years of rock.

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: Singer-songwriter Chris Rea was born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Chris Rea's 76th
angles.copy: Remembering Chris Rea, who would have turned 76 today. Still driving home for... his birthday.
